title: Do not remarry a divorced former wife after her intervening marriage
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: The former Israelite husband in the stated remarriage case
verse_text: [24:1] And if a man takes a wife and dwells with her as husband, and she finds no favour in his sight, because he has found some unseemly thing in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, and gives it into her hands, and sends her forth out of his house, [24:2] and she departs and becomes another man’s wife, [24:3] and the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, and gives it into her hands, and sends her forth out of his house, or if the latter husband who took her to be his wife dies, [24:4] her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after she has been defiled; for it is an abomination before the Lord your God. And you shall not defile the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession.
maimonides: P213: Marry a wife by formal betrothal (kiddushin)
P222: Divorce only by giving a written bill of divorce
N356: Do not remarry your divorcee after she married another

title: Exempt the newly married man from war and other imposed duty for one year
original_audience: Israel, including those assigning military or public service and the newly married man
verse_text: [24:5] And if a man has newly taken a wife, he shall not go forth unto war, neither shall any duty be laid upon him. He shall be free in his house one year, and shall gladden his wife whom he has taken.
maimonides: N311: A bridegroom must not be conscripted or burdened for a year

title: Newly married husband: gladden your wife during the prescribed year at home
original_audience: An Israelite man in the stated first year of marriage
verse_text: [24:5] And if a man has newly taken a wife, he shall not go forth unto war, neither shall any duty be laid upon him. He shall be free in his house one year, and shall gladden his wife whom he has taken.
maimonides: P214: A bridegroom stays home a year to gladden his wife

title: Do not take the livelihood-sustaining mill or millstone in pledge
original_audience: Israelite creditors taking pledges
verse_text: [24:6] You shall not take a mill or its upper stone in pledge, for he who does so takes a life in pledge.
maimonides: N242: Do not take food-preparing utensils such as millstones in pledge

title: Do not enter the debtor's house to seize a pledge
original_audience: Israelite creditors seeking a debtor's pledge
verse_text: [24:10] If your neighbour owes a debt, any debt whatsoever, you shall not enter his house to take his pledge.
maimonides: N239: Do not enter a debtor's house to seize a pledge

title: Pay the worker's wages at the prescribed time
original_audience: Israelite employers of poor and needy workers, including Israelites and resident foreigners
context_note: The New Testament does not repeat every ancient sunset deadline as a universal payroll schedule.
verse_text: [24:14] You shall not withhold the wages of the poor and needy, whether of your brethren or of the sojourners within your cities. [24:15] On the same day you shall pay his wages; the sun shall not go down upon them, for he is poor and sets his hope upon them; lest he cry against you unto the Lord, and there be sin upon you.
maimonides: P200: Pay a hired worker's wages on the same day

title: Do not execute parents for children's sins or children for parents' sins
original_audience: Israel, especially authorities administering capital judgments
context_note: Amaziah applies the existing law on individual responsibility for offenses. The Chronicles account supplies a parallel application. The Chronicler also records Amaziah applying the Torah rule.
verse_text: [24:16] Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers. Each shall die for his own sin.
maimonides: N287: Do not accept testimony from relatives

title: Do not take the widow's garment in pledge
original_audience: Israelite creditors taking pledges
verse_text: [24:17] You shall not pervert the judgment of the sojourner, or of the orphan, or of the widow; neither shall you take a widow’s garment in pledge.
maimonides: N241: Do not take a pledge from a widow

title: Do not pervert the judgment of the sojourner, orphan or widow
original_audience: Israel
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses Israel in this passage.
verse_text: [24:17] You shall not pervert the judgment of the sojourner, or of the orphan, or of the widow; neither shall you take a widow’s garment in pledge.
maimonides: N280: Do not pervert the judgment of strangers or orphans

title: Do not return for a forgotten harvest sheaf
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite grain harvesters
verse_text: [24:19] And when you reap your harvest in your field, and forget a sheaf in your field, you shall not return to take it. It shall be for the poor, and for the sojourner, and for the orphan, and for the widow; that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works of your hands.
maimonides: P122: Leave the forgotten sheaf for the poor
N214: Do not go back to take a forgotten sheaf

title: Do not glean the remaining olives after the first gathering
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite olive harvesters
verse_text: [24:20] And when you gather your olives, you shall not return to glean what remains behind you. It shall be for the sojourner, and for the orphan, and for the widow. And you shall remember that you were a household slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.

title: Give lashes under judicial supervision in proportion to the offense, with a maximum of forty
original_audience: Israelites administering or supervising judicial lashes
verse_text: [25:2] then it shall be, if the ungodly man is worthy of stripes, that you shall seat him before the judges, and they shall scourge him before them, by number according to his ungodliness. [25:3] They shall give him forty stripes, and shall not add thereto; lest, if they add more stripes beyond these, your brother be dishonoured before you.
maimonides: P224: Flog the guilty as the court prescribes
N300: Do not exceed the prescribed number of lashes

title: Do not muzzle the ox while it threshes
original_audience: Israelites whose ox treads out grain
context_note: This is a situational duty concerning work and provision, rather than an action every believer performs.
verse_text: [25:4] You shall not muzzle an ox when it treads out the grain.
maimonides: N219: Do not muzzle an ox while it threshes

title: The childless widow in the stated levirate case: do not marry outside the prescribed kinship
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: An Israelite widow in the childless marriage case
verse_text: [25:5] And if brethren dwell together, and one of them dies, and has no seed, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside unto a man who is not near of kin. Her husband’s brother shall go in unto her, and take her unto himself for a wife, and dwell with her as husband.
maimonides: N357: The levirate widow must not marry an outsider

title: The surviving brother in the stated levirate case: undertake the prescribed marriage duty
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: The surviving brother in the stated childless marriage case
verse_text: [25:5] And if brethren dwell together, and one of them dies, and has no seed, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside unto a man who is not near of kin. Her husband’s brother shall go in unto her, and take her unto himself for a wife, and dwell with her as husband.
maimonides: P216: Marry the widow of a brother who died childless

title: Establish the child of the levirate marriage in the deceased brother's name
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: Israel, with the child and kinship household in the stated marriage case
verse_text: [25:6] And it shall be, that the child whom she bears shall be established in the name of the dead, and his name shall not be blotted out of Israel.
maimonides: P216: Marry the widow of a brother who died childless

title: Apply the prescribed household designation after the levirate refusal
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: Israel as the community using the designation
verse_text: [25:10] And his name shall be called in Israel: The House of Him Whose Sandal Was Loosed.

title: Apply the prescribed penalty in the stated genital-seizure case
original_audience: Israel administering judgment in the specified struggle
verse_text: [25:11] And if men strive together, a man with his brother, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that strikes him, and puts forth her hand, and seizes his testicles, [25:12] you shall cut off her hand; your eye shall not spare her.
maimonides: P247: Save the pursued, even by killing the pursuer
N293: Do not take pity on a pursuer

title: Do not keep differing sets of weights or measures
original_audience: Israelites using weights or measures
verse_text: [25:13] You shall not have in your pouch differing weights, a great and a small. [25:14] You shall not have in your house differing measures, a great and a small.
maimonides: N272: Do not possess inaccurate weights and measures

title: Do not accept payment to kill an innocent person
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
original_audience: Israel affirming the covenant, with the bribe-taker subject to the sanction
verse_text: [27:25] Cursed is he who takes a bribe to slay an innocent life. And all the people shall say: So be it.
